$comment: Channel eligibility rules (OD-05). Data, not code — changing these is a config edit, not a release. Rules are evaluated at SEND time, not at schedule time: a recipient eligible when the batch was previewed may be ineligible when the batch fires. The send path re-checks and skips with a recorded reason.
status: UNVERIFIED — see docs/decisions/OD-05.md. Until the provider rules are confirmed, Email and SMS are the default channels and Messenger/WhatsApp are opt-in per business.

email.notes: Deliverability depends on SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Marketing content needs an explicit opt-in separate from transactional.

sms.notes: STOP/STOPALL must suppress the record for that phone number on every future send, not just the current batch.

messenger.notes: Outside the free-reply window a message needs a message tag; tag categories and their rules must be verified before enabling.

whatsapp.notes: Needs an approved business-initiated template. Template approval lead time must be planned around before enabling.

skip_reasons.no_consent: No consent record for this channel and purpose.
skip_reasons.no_verified_identity: No verified identity link for this channel.
skip_reasons.outside_free_reply_window: The provider's free-reply window has closed.
skip_reasons.opted_out: The customer has opted out on this channel.
skip_reasons.no_valid_contact_value: No usable contact value on this channel.
skip_reasons.channel_not_enabled: This channel is not enabled for the business.
